text: This is what a sound looks like.
One tone goes left, another goes right. A beam draws where they meet.
Tune the second a little sharp, and the shape turns. That turning is the beating the ear picks up.
Slow it down. Closer. Three to two, and it stops.
A perfect fifth, held still. Three touches across the top, two down the side.
Every simple ratio has its own shape. An octave. A fourth. A major third.
Pull it out of ratio and the shape tangles. The ear calls that rough. So does the eye.
Every shape you saw was drawn by the score. None was animated. It was played.
